entries.label: kitakami_center_before_01_01
entries.text: Welcome to Kitakami Hall! Not long now before\nthe big festival starts again!

entries.label: kitakami_center_before_08_01
entries.text: Snorlax is known as the Sleeping Pokémon, eh?\nPretty clear where that category comes from!

entries.label: kitakami_center_before_12_01
entries.text: We’ve got a real fun game in the works for you.\nCome on by once the Festival of Masks starts!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_01_01
entries.text: Good kids, bad kids, kids at heart—Kitakami Hall\nwelcomes one and all to the Festival of Masks!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_01_02
entries.text: I just saw someone run upstairs wearing a Loyal\nThree costume. They must be sweltering in there!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_01_03
entries.text: Wait, so that thing I saw before really WAS one\nof the Loyal Three? I knew I should’ve filmed it!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_09_01
entries.text: I want to buy a mask, but no one’s at the stall!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_09_02
entries.text: They opened the stall back up! I should be able\nto buy a mask now.

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_10_01
entries.text: So many masks! Which one should I choose?

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_10_02
entries.text: With a Pikachu mask, you’ll have a pika-pika day!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_16_01
entries.text: Fanning cools me down, but flapping my arm like\nthis makes me hot and sweaty all over again...

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_20_01
entries.text: Every year, masks of the Loyal Three are the first\nthings to fly off the shelves!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_20_02
entries.text: Is it true that the Loyal Three came back to life?\c\nMaybe if I wear one of their masks, get close to\nthem—even get to know them...

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_20_03
entries.text: The real Fezandipiti wasn’t as pink as I thought it\nwould be... What’s the OPPOSITE of serendipity?

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_21_01
entries.text: Munkidori’s mask is so awesome and blue!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_21_02
entries.text: Wait, the Loyal Three really exist? All this time I\nthought it was just an old folktale...

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_21_03
entries.text: The real Munkidori’s blue coloring was so...sickly.\nI hope it’s feeling hunky-dory...

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_22_01
entries.text: When I put on a mask, I feel like I’ve become an\nentirely different me!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_22_02
entries.text: I always thought the ogre was nothing more than\na tall tale the adults spun up to make kids listen!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_22_03
entries.text: Okidogi was a bad guy? That’s not okeydokey\nat all!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_25_01
entries.text: That human depicted on the old signboards...\nI wonder if that’s the Loyal Three’s Trainer.

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_31_01
entries.text: Step right on up for a round of Ogre Oustin’!\nHave a go and win some wonderful prizes!

entries.label: kitakami_center_after_55_01
entries.text:
You’ll need to ride a Pokémon if you want to
have a go at Ogre Oustin’!\c
But don’t worry—we’ve got a Stantler right here
for folks without a ridable Pokémon of their own!
